articles.title: Spanish scientists find first signs of Diplodocus in Europe - DW.com
articles.description: Paleontologists in Spain say they have found the first evidence of the long-necked Diplodocus genus of dinosaur outside of North America. They found bones at the rich La Tejeria fossil site in Teruel in eastern Spain.
articles.content:
Researchers writing in the Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology
